answer: The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. What survives to the nadir is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. A knoll of per-task receipts records who did what, and the lotus of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
